statement: The work is a painting rather than a diagram.
visual evidence / reason: A continuous representational painted scene, without diagram structure.

statement: Every part has Ketu quality and no other quality.
visual evidence / reason: Exclusive symbolic quality is not a property that pixels can prove.

statement: It holds no word, letter, numeral, or glyph.
visual evidence / reason: No writing or glyphs are visible.

statement: Both readings of paired correspondences are present.
visual evidence / reason: This meta-claim cannot be independently resolved visually.

statement: Desert frontier at dusk.
visual evidence / reason: Sparse sandy ground, haze, and waning light depict an arid frontier at dusk.

statement: The setting is southwest.
visual evidence / reason: No compass marker establishes southwest.

statement: Hill fort on far ridge.
visual evidence / reason: A crenellated fortress sits on the distant central ridge.

statement: Comet: fiery apparition with long smoke tail.
visual evidence / reason: A bright red-orange head crosses the sky with a long smoky trail.

statement: Full moon near comet darkened by eclipse.
visual evidence / reason: A round dark red lunar disc is visible beside the comet.

statement: Figure high on rock, elevated and lean.
visual evidence / reason: A very lean figure stands above the landscape on a high rock.

statement: Ascetic bearing a weapon.
visual evidence / reason: Ragged ascetic presentation and long spear/trident-like weapon are clear.

statement: Fierce red gaze and venomous tongue.
visual evidence / reason: Eyes glow red and a long red tongue protrudes.

statement: Breathing smoke.
visual evidence / reason: A grey plume issues from the mouth/nose region.

statement: Smoky brilliance; body thins into air at edges.
visual evidence / reason: Hair, smoke, and rag edges dissolve into the atmosphere, though the central body remains solid.

statement: Rags and mixed cloth full of holes.
visual evidence / reason: Multi-toned garments are torn through with many holes.

statement: Tips a mud vessel pouring seed.
visual evidence / reason: The left hand tilts a brown clay pot and a long stream of individual seeds pours out.

statement: Wind carries seed over ground.
visual evidence / reason: The seed stream arcs far to the right with the wind.

statement: Green shoots where seed has fallen.
visual evidence / reason: Several fresh green shoots rise at the receiving end of the seed arc.

statement: Anthill and dark snake hole at feet.
visual evidence / reason: A perforated mound and black burrow opening sit below the rock.

statement: Serpent and thorn bushes.
visual evidence / reason: An upright cobra and thorny vegetation are prominent.

statement: Donkey, ram, wolf, camel and owl at distance.
visual evidence / reason: All five animals are visible across left and middle distance.

statement: Insects in air.
visual evidence / reason: Numerous winged insects surround the figure.

statement: Horse gram.
visual evidence / reason: Seeds are visible in pot, air, and ground, but species cannot be securely identified.

statement: One blue stone with line of light across it.
visual evidence / reason: A blue oval stone on the rock has a bright diagonal band.

statement: Wide canvas empties toward one side.
visual evidence / reason: Landscape format opens into a large bare right-hand expanse.

statement: Forms whole at left, coming apart to right; right ground bare.
visual evidence / reason: Dense figure/animals/vegetation at left give way to windblown seeds, sparse shoots, haze, and bare right ground.

statement: Ash-pale smoky light.
visual evidence / reason: Pale grey-brown haze and smoke spread across the scene.

statement: Three red-fire points: gaze, comet head, eclipsed moon.
visual evidence / reason: Red eye, comet head, and lunar disc make three separated red accents.

statement: Paint scraped/rubbed thin and broken; weave and bare ground show.
visual evidence / reason: Surface visibly simulates abrasion, thin scumbles, exposed weave/ground, and worn edges.

statement: Scattered separate touches like things let go.
visual evidence / reason: Seeds, insects, rag fragments, and sparse marks scatter freely across open space.

statement: Ash grey, smoke, bone white, dull earth, red points, one blue.
visual evidence / reason: The stated restrained palette matches the visible image.

statement: Malefic figure associated with southwest and touch.
visual evidence / reason: Fearsome appearance is visible; astrological nature, compass association, and touch are not.

statement: Ketu as southward crossing and eclipse myth.
visual evidence / reason: An eclipsed moon is shown; orbital direction/crossing and mythic identity are not independently visible.

statement: Point of release: assimilated matter leaves as waste or seed.
visual evidence / reason: The figure visibly releases a stream of seed from its vessel.

statement: Spontaneous giving can help others at cost to giver.
visual evidence / reason: Seed and new shoots suggest giving/help; spontaneity and cost to giver cannot be established.

statement: Fearsome and harsh.
visual evidence / reason: Fierce eyes, weapon, protruding tongue, and gauntness visibly create a fearsome harsh presence.

statement: Turns toward acquired/inherited things; holding is inertia, letting go integrates life.
visual evidence / reason: Release is pictured, but acquisition, inheritance, inertia, and integration are abstract and not visually testable.

statement: Moon at bends/crossings changes human mind and activity.
visual evidence / reason: No comparative human mental state or orbital geometry is shown.

statement: Elevated lean figure, fierce gaze, venomous tongue, windy constitution.
visual evidence / reason: Every exterior feature is visible; wind appears in smoke, hair, rags, and seeds.

statement: Snake catcher, soldier, and religious life.
visual evidence / reason: The single ascetic bears a weapon, supporting religious/soldier readings; no snake-catching act is shown.

statement: Mud vessel, mixed cloth, rags, holes, arms, and smoke breath.
visual evidence / reason: All listed objects/features appear clearly.

statement: Anthill, dark snake hole, or forest.
visual evidence / reason: Anthill and dark hole are present; no forest is required by the disjunction.

statement: Hill forts, deserts and frontier districts.
visual evidence / reason: Distant fort and arid frontier visibly combine these allocations.

statement: Ketu denotes a fiery cometary apparition in separate usage.
visual evidence / reason: The painting prominently includes a fiery comet.

statement: Allotment does not identify Ketu with natal crossing or expressly name comet.
visual evidence / reason: This textual distinction cannot be tested against the picture.

statement: Horse gram.
visual evidence / reason: Rendered seeds cannot be identified to species from appearance.

statement: Donkey, ram, wolf, camel, serpent, owl, insects, bushes.
visual evidence / reason: Every listed animal and the thorny bush cluster are visible.

statement: Blue stone may be lapis, turquoise, cat’s eye, or unnamed species.
visual evidence / reason: Blue banded stone is clear; mineral species cannot be visually settled.

statement: Smoky brilliance and fierce red gaze as separate portrait features.
visual evidence / reason: Smoky body/air and red eyes are separately legible.

statement: Bruised limbs.

statement: Approaching alignment can intensify posture/movement disorders.
visual evidence / reason: Chart geometry and medical causal claim are not visually available.
